title: Project idea: a tiny money ledger
why_it_matters: Fintech-style projects test care with data and edge cases.
explanation: Build an expense or wallet tracker. Store amounts as integer cents, format them with Intl, and never allow a negative balance without a rule. Add a transaction history and filters. Tests and clean data modelling will impress reviewers.
try_it: Write down three rules your ledger must never break.
